ui_download.err.title: Download error
ui_download.err.console: The cause could not be determined. Open the F8 console to see the details.
ui_download.err.help:
If the error is "HTTP server file mismatch", "Unable to delete old file" or "File not readable":
1. Open the MTA folder (usually C:\Program Files (x86)\MTA San Andreas 1.6).
2. Open the properties of the "mods" folder and turn off the read-only attribute.
3. Restart MTA:SA.
